§29.14 Orthogonality

ⓘ
Keywords:
Lamé polynomials, orthogonality
Notes:
See Arscott (1964b, §9.4) and Erdélyi et al. (1955, §15.7).
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/29.14
See also:
Annotations for Ch.29

Lamé polynomials are orthogonal in two ways. First, the orthogonality relations (29.3.19) apply; see §29.12(i). Secondly, the system of functions

29.14.1 fnm⁡(s,t)=𝑢𝐸2⁢nm⁡(s,k2)⁢𝑢𝐸2⁢nm⁡(K⁡+i⁢t,k2),
n=0,1,2,…, m=0,1,…,n,
ⓘ
Defines:
fnm⁡(s,t): system (locally)
Symbols:
𝑢𝐸2⁢nm⁡(z,k2): Lamé polynomial, K⁡(k): Legendre’s complete elliptic integral of the first kind, i: imaginary unit, m: nonnegative integer, n: nonnegative integer and k: real parameter

Encodings:

29.14.2 ⟨g,h⟩=∫0K⁡∫0K′⁡w⁡(s,t)⁢g⁡(s,t)⁢h⁡(s,t)⁢dt⁢ds,
ⓘ
Symbols:
K′⁡(k): Legendre’s complementary complete elliptic integral of the first kind, K⁡(k): Legendre’s complete elliptic integral of the first kind, dx: differential of x, ∫: integral, k: real parameter and w⁡(s,t): function

29.14.3 w⁡(s,t)=sn2⁡(K⁡+i⁢t,k)−sn2⁡(s,k).
ⓘ

sn⁡(z,k): Jacobian elliptic function, K⁡(k): Legendre’s complete elliptic integral of the first kind, i: imaginary unit, k: real parameter and w⁡(s,t): function

In each system n ranges over all nonnegative integers and m=0,1,…,n. When combined, all eight systems (29.14.1) and (29.14.4)–(29.14.10) form an orthogonal and complete system with respect to the inner product

29.14.11 ⟨g,h⟩=∫04⁢K⁡∫02⁢K′⁡w⁡(s,t)⁢g⁡(s,t)⁢h⁡(s,t)⁢dt⁢ds,
ⓘ

K′⁡(k): Legendre’s complementary complete elliptic integral of the first kind, K⁡(k): Legendre’s complete elliptic integral of the first kind, dx: differential of x, ∫: integral, k: real parameter and w⁡(s,t): function
